newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Tatarstan plans Eurobond issue in summer.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Tatarstan plans Eurobond issue in summer.

text.p: Russia's Tatarstan republic plans to issue dollar-denominated Eurobonds in summer and is now in talks with potential lead-managers and rating agencies, a Tatarstan government official said on Wednesday.

"The (Tatarstan) cabinet made such a decision and now we are preparing documents and considering bids from rating agencies and financial companies for the position of lead managers," the head of the Tatarstan Finance Ministry's Securities Department, Konstantin Kolesnik, told Reuters.
He said Price Waterhouse would audit the republic's finances.
Tatarstan joins a long queue of Russian cities and regions, including Svedlovsk and Nizhny Novgorod, Moscow and St Petersburg, which plan to issue Eurobonds this year.
The issues are being held up by the government's failure so far to issue a promised regulation clarifying tax and financial terms for the issues.
